title: macOS release restored
summary: Todoz is available again for both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs with the away-tracking improvements from the previous update.
highlights: Install the latest Todoz update on Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
fixes: Fixed the macOS release build so lock, unlock, sleep, and wake improvements can be delivered to Mac users.

title: Reliable away tracking on macOS
summary: Todoz now handles macOS lock, unlock, sleep, and wake events more reliably so timers and away time stay accurate.
highlights: See the welcome-back window after returning from a screen lock or system sleep on macOS.
Categorize time spent away from your Mac just like on Windows.
fixes: Fixed macOS sleep handling so Todoz pauses active timers without interfering with system sleep.
Fixed activity tracking remaining paused after a brief absence or if the welcome-back window could not open.

title: Seamless Todoz migration on Windows
summary: This update consolidates renamed Windows installations so existing MyTodos users continue in Todoz without repeated update prompts.
highlights: Continue automatically from legacy MyTodos shortcuts and start-at-login entries into the current Todoz installation.
fixes: Fixed the Todoz rename creating a side-by-side Windows installation and repeatedly offering the same update.
Preserved the existing Todoz database and settings while migrating installer registrations.

title: Introducing Todoz
summary: MyTodos is now Todoz, with refreshed branding throughout the desktop experience while preserving your existing data, settings, and update path.
highlights: See the Todoz name across the app window, header, Settings, tray menu, backup experience, and Google sign-in flow.
Install and update with newly branded Todoz desktop packages.
Keep all existing projects, tasks, time entries, settings, and integrations unchanged after updating.
fixes: Improved release publishing so updater manifests reliably follow the renamed installer assets on every supported desktop platform.

title: Focused task sessions and durable activity tracking
summary: This update adds self-managed task sessions, reliable AFK categories, and a What's New experience for future releases.
highlights: Set a bounded focus timer from any task's context menu.
Choose another task or continue with regular untimed tracking when a focus session ends.
Keep AFK categories synchronized through SQLite across development and installed builds.
See release highlights before updating and after the updated app relaunches.
fixes: Fixed one-minute custom task timers failing to start.
Fixed the task-timer completion window actions appearing unresponsive.
Preserved historical AFK entries when categories are removed from the picker.
